title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 24: wisdom that builds a house, the righteous who rise again, and the sluggard's field.

questions.text: Through what is a house built, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:3 says through wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established.

questions.text: Where does this chapter say victory is found?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:6 says by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

questions.text: What does it show if you falter in the time of trouble?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:10 says if you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

questions.text: What does this chapter tell a son to eat, because it is good and sweet to the taste?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:13 says my son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste.

questions.text: How many times does a righteous man fall and rise up again, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:16 says a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

questions.text: What does this chapter say you should not do when your enemy falls?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:17 says don't rejoice when your enemy falls, and don't let your heart be glad when he is overthrown.

questions.text: What will happen to the lamp of the wicked, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:20 says there will be no reward to the evil man; the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

answers.text: It will flicker in the wind
It will be taken by the righteous

questions.text: What is an honest answer compared to in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:26 says an honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

answers.text: Cold water to a thirsty soul

questions.text: According to this chapter, when should you build your house?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:27 says prepare your work outside and get your fields ready; afterwards, build your house.

answers.text: In the days of your youth
When your sons are fully grown

questions.text: What did the speaker see when he went by the field of the sluggard?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 24:30-31 says the field of the sluggard was all grown over with thorns, its surface covered with nettles, and its stone wall broken down.

answers.text: It was all grown over with thorns
It was ripe for harvest with no one to reap
It was sold to his neighbor
It was trampled down by cattle
